svg.aria-label: What teamrig-pane does for you: Your tasks, always in view. Docked beside the conversation, in plan order, updated as they change. The whole team at a glance. Every owner's tasks in one view, with how many are active or blocked. What needs you stands out. Blocked, overdue, new and not picked up are marked; blocked ones say why. Details on a click. The ask in its own words, who asked and when, and the latest status note. Changes, one press away. Each changed file and its lines, in every repo the session works in. Fast, and costs no tokens. It reads files, never the model, and only when they change.
